description: Numbeo cost-of-living prices for one city from its public page: item label and the crowd-sourced price with currency symbol (e.g. meal at an inexpensive restaurant, one-way ticket). Prices are user-submitted estimates, not official. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name as Numbeo writes it, e.g. Paris or New-York (letters, spaces, hyphens, 2 to 60 characters)
